title: Sources: the Trump administration is quietly debating whether to ban Chinese-made cellular modules, as the US FCC pushes measures to reduce Beijing's threats (Demetri Sevastopulo/Financial Times)
summary: Demetri Sevastopulo / Financial Times: Sources: the Trump administration is quietly debating whether to ban Chinese-made cellular modules, as the US FCC pushes measures to reduce Beijing's threats — FCC chair Brendan Carr cracks down on goods from drones to routers despite trade thaw with Beijing
